title: The Name That Returns / 奥德赛·归来之名

sections.rhythm: Isolated two-note domestic question; no drums
sections.development: 门前留白：归家主题只说前两个音。

sections.rhythm: Bronze drum phalanx: 0, 1.5, 2.75; alternating shield replies
sections.development: 青铜低鼓与错位帧鼓，短铜管宣叙；不是EDM四踩。

sections.rhythm: Broad theme over rowing half-notes and flowing lyra
sections.development: 旋律舒展，F#点亮Dorian；里拉琴左右应答。

sections.rhythm: Uneven low strikes: 0 / 1.75 / 3.25, every other bar incomplete
sections.development: 半音地板、窄脉冲与不对称低鼓；大空间中仍有空隙。
先拨弦试探，再震音聚力，铜管重击，最后半拍脉冲脱离。

sections.rhythm: Triumphal dotted calls fracture into falling chromatic stabs
sections.development: 前三小节虚假大调胜利；随后移调崩落，不用同伴奏只降音量。

sections.rhythm: 3+3+2 eighth-note accents with two independent interlocking lines
sections.development: 通透FM铃与脉冲复调；节拍仍为144，错觉来自重音而非改速。

sections.rhythm: Six-register calls against 3+2+3 low drums and oar ostinato
sections.development: 六个声部按不同音区和声像探下；损失一刻抽掉领奏，鼓阵仍逼迫向前。

sections.rhythm: Rotating tremolo, displaced thunder and widening surf; then subtraction
sections.development: 危机靠音区、海浪滤波、错位低鼓与撤去领奏建立，不只是加响。

sections.rhythm: Exposed solo with long unaccompanied gaps over a quiet sustained floor
sections.development: 独奏拨弦拾起归家动机；没有鼓和合奏垫底。

sections.rhythm: Complete home melody, soft inner-voice suspensions; no percussion
sections.development: 归家主题第一次完整暖色呈现。

sections.rhythm: Plucks contract; continuous ten-beat draw ends exactly at release
sections.development: 从稀疏拨弦收缩到弦张力升音；放箭与斧孔声由共享动作点触发。

sections.key: A Dorian; two themes in counterpoint
sections.rhythm: Full eight-bar expedition above independent four-bar home twice
sections.development: 双主题八小节交织；结尾按字幕逐层撤军鼓，为识认留出空间。

sections.rhythm: No drums or inherited drum reverberation; sparse intimate replies
sections.development: 真正退出鼓阵，168.333秒只用柔和铃声确认识认。

sections.rhythm: Home reprise with augmented expedition fragments; drum-free cadence
sections.development: 归家旋律明亮而克制，远征只作长音回应；末1.5秒完整淡出。

cues.reason: 落水后缺掉一拍，随即回到孤独拨弦；不是时间轴暂停。

render.sfxProofScope: Actual isolated dry DSP onset and energy against simultaneous music before mastering; encoded onset localization cannot isolate a sound inside a composite mix.

music.synthesis: Deterministic polyBLEP pulse, additive triangle, fractional-delay digital lyra, detuned low brass and tremolo strings, FM bells, mathematical drum/metal/noise/SFX. No borrowed musical material.

processing.signalChain: Bar-streamed float32 -> 27Hz HP/16.5kHz LP -> measured FIXED gain -> stereo-linked 192kHz limiter (level=false, latency=true) -> 48kHz -> sample-exact full-bus hold -> 24bit WAV -> 256k gapless MP3

provenance.sources: Only score.mjs mathematics and story.mjs shared markers; no network, samples, narration, voice clone, film score recording or transcription.
provenance.engineering: Streaming PCM, fractional delay and fixed-gain measurement techniques adapted from local rdr2 DSP; all pitches, motifs, rhythmic forms and section arrangements newly authored.

delivery.playback: Standard gapless MP3 for native audio playback; no generated video or HTML.

checks: fresh EBU R128 / oversampled true peak for both files
15 unique musical structure hashes excluding gain
all 30 action cue DSP onsets within 8 samples
all local SFX at least 6dB below concurrent dry music
exact 20,000 zero stereo frames in archive hold
MP3 hold core below -85dBFS, full beat below -60dBFS
no drum voices or room memory at root
validation.scope: Computed signal and provenance verification, NOT a claim of listening or artistic approval.
